authorization: bounded read-only diagnosis; no service behaviour changed, nothing restarted or stopped, no limit raised, nothing deployed

current_oom_loop.cycle_derivation: process is SIGKILLed 1-2 s after start; RestartSec=30

journal_retention.disk_usage: Archived and active journals take up 555.7M in the file system.

current_oom_loop.correction_of_the_earlier_report: the loop is ~16 h old, not 7+ days. The journal retains 11 days of this unit and contains ZERO oom-kill events before 2026-09-06T04:51:05Z, so the shorter duration is a measurement, not a retention limit. The earlier '~114 kills/hour' rate is confirmed (116 observed); the 'for 7+ days' duration is not.

loop_is_not_consuming_disk.reason: the process dies BEFORE its append completes

root_cause.summary: an unbounded per-tick list inflated one ledger record past the chain primitive's fixed 256 KiB tail window, which forces that primitive onto a whole-file read of a 438 MB ledger, which exceeds the 512 MiB unit cap on every start

stage_1_generator.defect: MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS guards only the FIRST branch. The elif branch for externally supervised services appends one DEFERRED_TO_SUPERVISOR entry per tick with no cap.
stage_1_generator.state_reset: state['attempts'] is cleared only when the PHASE changes; the phase stayed IDLE across the weekend
stage_1_generator.amplification: the whole incident, including its entire attempt history, is re-serialised into EVERY tick record

stage_2_amplifier.fast_path: seek(size-262144) and parse the last entry_hash -- O(1)
stage_2_amplifier.defect: when no entry_hash is found in that fixed window it falls back to log_path.read_text() over the ENTIRE file

why_the_window_now_always_fails.consequence: the window can never contain a complete record; the single partial line is then discarded by the 'lines = lines[1:]' cut-guard, leaving zero candidates

measured_contained_read_only_reproductio.method: the prev-hash lookup alone, run in its own transient unit; read-only, appends nothing, starts no service
measured_contained_read_only_reproductio.requirement_vs_cap: 1267 MiB needed against a 512 MiB cap (2.5x over)

stage_2_amplifier.memory_attributed_to: the orchestrator's own cgroup, in the read call; not startup imports (14 MiB at that point), not a child process, and not overlapping work

root_cause.why_it_started_at_04_51: the last successful append was 04:50:03; that record was the first to exceed the tail window, so the next tick took the fallback and died
root_cause.self_sustaining: the loop no longer depends on in-memory state, which is empty after each restart. The oversized final record in the FILE is enough to reproduce it on every start.

useful_work_health.systemd_reports: activating / auto-restart (sampled 8 times over 32 s; one sample showed deactivating). It never showed 'active' during observation.
useful_work_health.masking_risk: 'systemctl is-active' returns activating, whose exit status is nonzero, so a status-code check is NOT fooled. A check that substring-matches 'active' in the text IS fooled, because 'activating' and 'deactivating' both contain it.
useful_work_health.honest_signal: the heartbeat, which records WORK rather than presence

heartbeat.note: the heartbeat is never updated because beat.work() runs only AFTER tick() returns, and tick() dies inside chain_append

useful_work_health.evidence_of_successful_work: 5661 completed ticks up to 04:50:03Z; none since
useful_work_health.gap: no orchestrator work has completed for over 16 hours

commissioning_impact.what_the_service_does: every 60 s it classifies the session phase, reconciles the expected roster against observed processes, starts what it owns, verifies FIRST WORK rather than liveness, and escalates SESSION_MISSED_START
reads: the tail of its own hash-chained ledger
commissioning_impact.launches: services it supervises directly (equity-fabric, options-paper); btc-paper and edgeforge-observatory are systemd-supervised and it only NOTICES those
commissioning_impact.parallax_commissioning: imports only session_bounds, a pure calendar function; unaffected by the daemon being down
commissioning_impact.capital_risk: none. decision_power is NONE_OPERATIONAL; the service never places an order and touches no trading rule
commissioning_impact.consequence_if_unrepaired: from 2026-09-08 no missed session start would be noticed or escalated, and the services the orchestrator itself starts would not be started
commissioning_impact.other_services: unaffected; only apex-orchestrator.service reports Result=oom-kill. Several heartbeats are current.

adjacent_observations_not_in_scope.detail: apex/ops/orchestrator.py defines session_bounds, phase_at, ArmCheck, evaluate_arm, StartAttempt, missed_start_verdict and reconcile_expected TWICE (first near lines 100-279, again near 326-487). Python keeps the later definition, so the earlier ones are dead code. Not the cause of this loop; a latent hazard.
apex-gate2-opener.service is in state failed (not an OOM).
the healthy long-lived instance peaked at 349.9 MiB against the 512 MiB cap, about 32 percent headroom, over a 4-day run.

other_chain_ledgers_surveyed.why: the fallback lives in a primitive shared by every ledger writer, so the question is whether any other ledger is already at the edge
other_chain_ledgers_surveyed.method: read-only: the same tail-window test the primitive performs, plus the size of the final complete record

false_positive_corrected.first_reading: the probe reported it as falling back
false_positive_corrected.on_inspection: its records carry no entry_hash at all -- it is written by apex/organism/experience.py, not by chain_append, so the primitive is never called on it and it cannot take the fallback. Reported here rather than dropped, because the first reading was wrong and the correction is the finding.

other_chain_ledgers_surveyed.conclusion: only the orchestrator ledger is affected today. The other four chain ledgers pass the window test with three orders of magnitude of margin. The hazard is latent for all of them: the 688 MB decisions ledger would need roughly 2 GB if one of its records ever exceeded the window.

verdicts.CURRENT_OOM_LOOP: OCCURRING -- confirmed live, 31 s cycle, 116 kills/hour, began 2026-09-06T04:51:05Z (~16 h, not 7+ days)
verdicts.ROOT_CAUSE: IDENTIFIED AND REPRODUCED -- unbounded per-tick attempt list inflated one record past the chain primitive's 256 KiB tail window, forcing a whole-file read of 438 MB needing 1267 MiB against a 512 MiB cap
verdicts.USEFUL_WORK_HEALTH: NO USEFUL WORK SINCE 2026-09-06T04:50:03Z -- 5661 ticks completed before that, none since; the heartbeat is honest and frozen, systemd reports activating
verdicts.COMMISSIONING_IMPACT: NO SESSION MISSED YET, DEADLINE 2026-09-08 -- the 5th, 6th and 7th are not trading days; from the 8th no missed start would be noticed or escalated. No capital risk: decision_power is NONE_OPERATIONAL
verdicts.REPAIR_PROPOSAL_READINESS: READY -- two files, two independent defects, either fix alone stops the loop; no limit change justified and no data mutation required
